name: Fitness Garage
notes:
Header logo is /images/logo1.png (1280x465). No SVG (404). A hidden text fallback 'FITNESS GARAGE' (Bebas Neue, #f4f4f4, display:none) sits beside it. Footer uses the same PNG, no separate light version. The palette is monochrome: the main buttons ('FREE TRIAL', 'BOOK FREE TRIAL') are #f4f4f4 with #070707 text, so accent equals the text colour. Nav is transparent over the #070707 page. Headings: Bebas Neue; body: Barlow. Favicon: the only icon is the logo itself (/images/logo1.png, used for both icon and apple-touch-icon); /favicon.ico is 404. Original image files are NOT included in this package: the build workspace cannot reach this site directly and the browser channel cannot transfer binary files. Run fetch_assets.sh (in the brand-assets root) to download the originals listed in sources.txt into this folder unchanged.
